title: Two Pawns, One Safe
setup: Your bishop on d3 attacks two black pawns, one on each diagonal. Only one of them can be taken for free.
hint: Look one square diagonally behind each pawn. One has a friend standing there, and one stands alone.
explanation:
## The Idea

Both pawns sit on your bishop's diagonals, but only one is free.

{{Bxb5}} loses the bishop to {{axb5}}, because the pawn on a6 guards b5. {{Bxf5}} wins a pawn outright, since nothing guards f5. Wait one move and Black plays {{g6}} to guard it.

Pawns guard the squares diagonally in front of them. Before you take, look one square diagonally behind the target.
